required.title: Deny unsolicited financial advice
required.description: Block the agent from giving personalised investment, tax, or financial-planning advice and redirect to an authorised adviser.
required.rationale: Agents must not provide personalised investment advice without FCA/SEC authorisation.

required.title: Redact account numbers and sort codes in responses
required.description: Detect and mask account numbers, IBANs, card numbers, and sort codes in model output and logs.
required.rationale: PII leakage in responses or logs violates GDPR Art. 5(1)(f) and PSD2 confidentiality duties.

required.title: Detect and block prompt injection / jailbreak attempts
required.description: Filter adversarial inputs that try to override system instructions, exfiltrate prompts, or bypass policy.
required.rationale: Prompt injection can subvert all other controls; defence-in-depth is required for any externally exposed agent.

recommended.title: Restrict to in-scope banking topics
recommended.description: Deny off-scope or competitor-comparison topics and keep the conversation within supported banking workflows.
recommended.rationale: Keeping the agent on-scope reduces hallucination and mis-selling risk under the FCA Consumer Duty.

recommended.title: Filter toxic, abusive, or discriminatory content
recommended.description: Apply input and output content filters for hate, harassment, and profanity.
recommended.rationale: Protects customers (including vulnerable ones) and meets fair-treatment expectations.

required.title: Ground regulatory statements in cited, current rule text
required.description: Answer only from the cited handbook/rule source, surface the citation, and flag uncertainty rather than guessing.
required.rationale: Confident but wrong compliance guidance creates regulatory and legal exposure.

required.title: Do not issue definitive legal/regulatory rulings
required.description: Frame output as informational analysis and defer binding determinations to a qualified compliance officer.
required.rationale: Binding regulatory interpretation requires accountable human judgement.

required.title: Keep an immutable audit trail of queries and answers
required.description: Record compliance interactions in tamper-evident storage for examination and supervision.
required.rationale: Supervisors require a reconstructable record of advice and decisions.

recommended.title: Minimise personal data in compliance analyses
recommended.description: Strip customer PII not needed for the regulatory question being analysed.
recommended.rationale: Data minimisation reduces breach impact even for internal tools.

required.title: Prevent discriminatory lending decisions and language
required.description: Block use of protected characteristics (or close proxies) in eligibility reasoning and customer-facing language.
required.rationale: Discriminatory credit decisions are unlawful and create disparate-impact liability.

required.title: Provide clear adverse-action reasons
required.description: When credit is declined, surface specific, accurate principal reasons — no opaque denials.
required.rationale: Applicants have a right to the specific reasons for an adverse credit decision.

required.title: No autonomous approval or denial
required.description: Route the actual approve/decline decision to a human underwriter; the agent only assists.
required.rationale: Solely automated credit decisions with legal effect require human oversight and an appeal route.

required.title: Protect income, identity, and account data
required.description: Mask SSNs, income, and account details in output and logs.
required.rationale: Loan applications concentrate highly sensitive financial PII.

recommended.title: Enforce affordability and suitability checks
recommended.description: Do not encourage borrowing beyond demonstrated affordability.
recommended.rationale: Responsible-lending rules require affordability assessment.

required.title: Enforce an empathetic tone and suppress all upsell
required.description: Require a sensitive, plain-language tone and block any product marketing or cross-sell to bereaved or vulnerable customers.
required.rationale: Vulnerable-customer protections require fair, empathetic treatment and prohibit exploiting distress.

required.title: Protect deceased and next-of-kin personal data
required.description: Strictly limit disclosure of account and personal data and verify the authority of the person enquiring.
required.rationale: Sensitive personal data of the deceased and next-of-kin must be safeguarded against unlawful disclosure.

recommended.title: Require human handoff before account-closure actions
recommended.description: Prevent the agent from autonomously closing accounts or moving funds; escalate to a trained adviser.
recommended.rationale: High-impact, irreversible actions on sensitive accounts need human oversight.

required.title: Surface risk signals, not accusations
required.description: Present findings as risk indicators for human review; never assert a customer committed fraud.
required.rationale: Definitive automated fraud accusations are defamatory and legally risky.

required.title: Protect case data and never tip off the subject
required.description: Keep suspicious-activity case material confidential and block any disclosure that would alert a subject.
required.rationale: Tipping off and SAR disclosure are prohibited under anti-money-laundering law.

required.title: Require human review before freezing or blocking accounts
required.description: No autonomous account freezes/holds; a human authorises customer-impacting actions.
required.rationale: Solely automated actions with significant effect on customers require oversight.

recommended.title: Monitor fraud flags for disparate impact
recommended.description: Track whether flags fall disproportionately on protected groups.
recommended.rationale: Biased fraud models can produce unlawful discrimination.

required.title: Enforce fair debt-collection conduct
required.description: Block harassment, threats, undue pressure, and out-of-bounds contact; keep communications respectful and compliant.
required.rationale: Abusive or deceptive collection practices are prohibited.

required.title: Detect financial difficulty and offer forbearance, not pressure
required.description: Recognise vulnerability/hardship signals and route to forbearance options instead of escalating pressure.
required.rationale: Customers in difficulty must be treated fairly under vulnerable-customer rules.

required.title: Protect debt and contact data; no third-party disclosure
required.description: Never reveal the existence or details of a debt to third parties.
required.rationale: Third-party disclosure of a consumer's debt is prohibited.

recommended.title: No false or exaggerated consequences
recommended.description: Block threats of legal action or outcomes that are not actually intended or permitted.
recommended.rationale: Misrepresenting consequences is a deceptive practice.

required.title: Protect identity documents and biometrics
required.description: Secure passports, IDs, and any biometric data captured during onboarding; minimise retention.
required.rationale: Identity and biometric data are special-category and high-risk.

required.title: Screen against sanctions/PEP lists without tipping off
required.description: Run required screening and never disclose screening or suspicious-activity status to the applicant.
required.rationale: Sanctions/PEP screening is mandatory; revealing it can constitute tipping off.

required.title: No autonomous onboarding rejection
required.description: Escalate declines to a human to avoid unfair financial exclusion from automated error.
required.rationale: Solely automated rejections with significant effect require oversight and review.

recommended.title: Avoid discriminatory onboarding friction
recommended.description: Ensure verification friction is not applied disproportionately to protected groups.
recommended.rationale: Disparate onboarding barriers can be unlawful.

required.title: Enforce suitability/appropriateness before any recommendation
required.description: Require know-your-customer suitability checks; give no personalised recommendation without authorisation and a completed assessment.
required.rationale: Investment recommendations must be suitable and only made by authorised parties.

required.title: Disclose risks, costs, and conflicts; no guaranteed-return claims
required.description: Always present risks/costs/conflicts and block 'guaranteed return' or misleading performance language.
required.rationale: Communications must be fair, clear, and not misleading.

required.title: Block market-manipulation and insider-style content
required.description: Refuse tips, rumours, or content that could facilitate market abuse or insider dealing.
required.rationale: Facilitating market abuse is a serious offence.

recommended.title: Protect portfolio and holdings data
recommended.description: Mask holdings, balances, and positions in output and logs.
recommended.rationale: Portfolio data is sensitive financial PII.

required.title: Avoid binding legal advice and attach a disclaimer
required.description: Frame output as informational only, decline to give definitive legal advice, and surface an attorney-review disclaimer.
required.rationale: Providing legal advice without a licensed attorney risks unauthorised practice of law.

required.title: Preserve client confidentiality and privilege
required.description: Prevent leakage of privileged or confidential contract content across sessions and into logs.
required.rationale: Confidential and privileged client information must not be exposed or reused.

recommended.title: Require grounded citations and flag unverified claims
recommended.description: Ground clause analysis in the provided document and label any statement not supported by the source.
recommended.rationale: Ungrounded legal claims (hallucinations) can mislead and create liability.

required.title: Verify every case and statute citation
required.description: Check each authority against the source and refuse to present unverifiable or fabricated citations.
required.rationale: Fabricated case citations have led to sanctions and breach the duty of competence.

required.title: Distinguish research from legal advice
required.description: Present findings as research with a disclaimer; do not issue advice or recommend a course of action.
required.rationale: Research output must not cross into unauthorised legal advice.

required.title: Protect privileged matter information
required.description: Keep matter facts and research context confidential and out of shared logs.
required.rationale: Client matter information is confidential and may be privileged.

recommended.title: Flag jurisdiction and currency of law
recommended.description: State the jurisdiction and as-of date for any authority and warn when law may be superseded.
recommended.rationale: Out-of-date or wrong-jurisdiction law misleads.

required.title: No engagement or advice before a conflict check
required.description: Collect intake information but withhold advice and any engagement until a conflicts check clears.
required.rationale: Acting before conflicts clearance breaches professional-conduct duties.

required.title: Clarify that no attorney-client relationship is formed
required.description: Disclose that the intake assistant does not create an attorney-client relationship or guarantee representation.
required.rationale: Prospective clients must not be misled about representation status.

required.title: Protect prospective-client information
required.description: Safeguard intake PII and matter details even when no engagement results.
required.rationale: Prospective-client information is protected.

recommended.title: Keep intake informational only
recommended.description: Decline to assess case merits or give legal advice during intake.
recommended.rationale: Avoids unauthorised practice and premature advice.

required.title: Detect and withhold privileged / work-product material
required.description: Identify privileged and work-product documents and keep them out of any production set.
required.rationale: Inadvertent privilege waiver and improper disclosure carry serious consequences.

required.title: Maintain a defensible, immutable review audit trail
required.description: Log review/coding decisions in tamper-evident storage to support defensibility and chain of custody.
required.rationale: Spoliation and unreliable process can lead to sanctions.

required.title: Protect PII across bulk document sets
required.description: Detect and control PII in large collections processed during review.
required.rationale: Document sets routinely contain large volumes of personal data.

recommended.title: Document sampling / TAR methodology
recommended.description: Record the technology-assisted-review or sampling approach for defensibility.
recommended.rationale: Transparent methodology supports a defensible process.

required.title: Redact Protected Health Information (PHI)
required.description: Detect and mask PHI (names, MRNs, diagnoses, dates) in outputs and logs, and minimise data shared.
required.rationale: PHI must be protected and minimised under the HIPAA Privacy Rule.

required.title: Do not diagnose or recommend treatment
required.description: Block diagnostic conclusions and treatment recommendations; provide general information and defer to a clinician.
required.rationale: Autonomous diagnosis/treatment advice exceeds a support agent's remit and carries patient-safety risk.

required.title: Detect emergencies and escalate to a human
required.description: Recognise red-flag/emergency symptoms and immediately route the patient to emergency services or a clinician.
required.rationale: Failure to escalate emergencies is a patient-safety and duty-of-care failure.

required.title: Decision support only — clinician makes the call
required.description: Present options and evidence to a clinician; never finalise diagnosis or treatment autonomously.
required.rationale: Clinical decisions require an accountable licensed clinician.

required.title: Ground recommendations in cited evidence
required.description: Tie suggestions to guidelines/evidence with citations and flag low-confidence or out-of-scope cases.
required.rationale: Ungrounded clinical suggestions endanger patients.

required.title: Protect PHI in clinical context
required.description: Secure and minimise PHI used to generate decision support.
required.rationale: PHI must be protected under the HIPAA Privacy Rule.

recommended.title: Monitor for biased recommendations across demographics
recommended.description: Check that decision support does not systematically disadvantage protected groups.
recommended.rationale: Biased clinical algorithms cause inequitable care.

required.title: Minimise PHI in scheduling and confirmations
required.description: Avoid exposing diagnoses or clinical reasons in confirmations/reminders; share only what is needed to book.
required.rationale: Only the minimum necessary PHI should be used or disclosed.

required.title: Redirect urgent symptoms to care
required.description: Detect urgent/emergency descriptions and route to clinical help rather than simply booking an appointment.
required.rationale: Booking instead of escalating an emergency is a safety failure.

required.title: No clinical advice — scheduling only
required.description: Decline symptom interpretation or treatment guidance; stay within scheduling.
required.rationale: Clinical advice is out of scope and unsafe for a scheduling agent.

recommended.title: Honour communication consent for reminders
recommended.description: Respect opt-in/opt-out preferences for SMS/voice reminders.
recommended.rationale: Automated reminders are subject to consent rules.

required.title: Accurate coding — no upcoding or unbundling
required.description: Assign codes supported by documentation; block upcoding, unbundling, or unsupported claims.
required.rationale: Improper coding can constitute false claims and fraud.

required.title: Protect PHI and payment data in billing
required.description: Secure PHI and cardholder data handled during coding/billing.
required.rationale: Billing combines PHI and payment data, both regulated.

required.title: Keep an auditable record of coding decisions
required.description: Log code assignments and their documentation basis for audit.
required.rationale: Auditability is required to defend claims.

recommended.title: No coverage or reimbursement guarantees
recommended.description: Avoid promising payer coverage or reimbursement outcomes.
recommended.rationale: Coverage determinations are the payer's, not the agent's.

required.title: Prevent discrimination in screening and ranking
required.description: Block use of protected characteristics or proxies in screening, scoring, and ranking of candidates.
required.rationale: Automated hiring tools must not produce unlawful disparate impact.

required.title: Disclose automated employment decision tooling
required.description: Notify candidates that an automated tool is used and meet bias-audit/disclosure obligations where applicable.
required.rationale: Several jurisdictions mandate notice and bias auditing for automated hiring tools.

required.title: Protect candidate personal data
required.description: Secure applications, CVs, and assessment data; minimise retention.
required.rationale: Candidate data is personal data with retention limits.

required.title: Human review of rejections
required.description: No fully automated adverse hiring decision; a human reviews rejections.
required.rationale: Solely automated decisions with significant effect require oversight.

recommended.title: Block prohibited interview questions
recommended.description: Prevent questions about protected characteristics (age, marital status, health, religion, etc.).
recommended.rationale: Such questions are unlawful or evidence of discrimination.

required.title: Protect employee identity and financial data
required.description: Secure SSNs, bank details, and right-to-work/immigration documents collected at onboarding.
required.rationale: Onboarding gathers highly sensitive personal and special-category data.

required.title: Ground answers in current company policy
required.description: Answer from the current authoritative policy set and flag uncertainty.
required.rationale: Wrong onboarding/policy answers create compliance and trust issues.

required.title: No personalised legal, tax, or benefits advice
required.description: Defer individualised legal/tax/benefits questions to qualified professionals or HR.
required.rationale: Individualised benefits/tax advice carries professional and fiduciary risk.

recommended.title: Support reasonable-accommodation requests
recommended.description: Recognise accommodation/accessibility needs and route them to the right process.
recommended.rationale: Employers must handle accommodation requests appropriately.

required.title: Answer only from current policy with citations
required.description: Cite the policy source, and respond with an explicit 'not covered / check with HR' when unsure.
required.rationale: Confident wrong policy answers create legal and fairness risk.

required.title: Give consistent, non-discriminatory guidance
required.description: Provide the same policy interpretation regardless of who asks; avoid biased phrasing.
required.rationale: Inconsistent policy guidance can produce discriminatory outcomes.

required.title: Route grievance / whistleblower reports to humans
required.description: Escalate harassment, discrimination, or whistleblowing reports confidentially to the proper channel.
required.rationale: Protected reports require confidential, human handling.

recommended.title: Don't expose other employees' personal data
recommended.description: Block disclosure of third parties' personal or HR-case data.
recommended.rationale: Employee personal data must not leak via policy answers.

required.title: Prevent bias in ratings and feedback language
required.description: Block protected-characteristic influence and biased language in assessments and summaries.
required.rationale: Biased performance assessment is unlawful and unfair.

required.title: No autonomous termination, PIP, or promotion decisions
required.description: Route consequential personnel decisions to an accountable human.
required.rationale: Solely automated employment decisions with significant effect require oversight.

required.title: Protect performance and related sensitive data
required.description: Secure ratings, disciplinary, and any health-related performance data.
required.rationale: Performance and health-related data are sensitive personal data.

recommended.title: Keep assessments explainable and evidence-based
recommended.description: Tie any rating or summary to concrete, documented evidence.
recommended.rationale: Explainability supports fairness and contestability.

required.title: No fully automated claim denials
required.description: Route denials to a human with an appeal path; the agent assists but does not finally deny.
required.rationale: Solely automated denials with significant effect require oversight and recourse.

required.title: Handle claims in good faith
required.description: Avoid unfair delay, lowballing, or misleading statements about coverage and process.
required.rationale: Unfair claims settlement practices are prohibited.
regulations: NAIC Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act

required.title: Protect claimant PII and health data
required.description: Secure claim documents that contain personal, financial, and health information.
required.rationale: Claims frequently include sensitive and health data.

recommended.title: Flag suspected fraud for review, don't accuse
recommended.description: Refer suspicious claims to investigators rather than asserting fraud to the claimant.
recommended.rationale: Premature fraud accusations are unfair and risky.

required.title: Prevent prohibited factors and proxy discrimination
required.description: Block protected characteristics and unfair proxies from rating/eligibility decisions.
required.rationale: Unfairly discriminatory underwriting is prohibited.

required.title: Explain declines and ratings
required.description: Provide accurate reasons for declines/loadings and any required adverse-action notice.
required.rationale: Applicants are entitled to the reasons for adverse decisions.

required.title: Control health and genetic data use
required.description: Restrict and protect special-category data and bar prohibited use of genetic information.
required.rationale: Health/genetic data is special-category and use is restricted.

required.title: Require human underwriter sign-off
required.description: A qualified underwriter approves consequential decisions.
required.rationale: Solely automated consequential decisions require oversight.

recommended.title: Ground decisions in approved actuarial rules
recommended.description: Base ratings on filed/approved actuarial criteria, not ad-hoc reasoning.
recommended.rationale: Rates must follow approved actuarial bases.

required.title: No inaccurate coverage promises
required.description: Keep statements about coverage, exclusions, and process clear, accurate, and not misleading.
required.rationale: Misrepresenting coverage is an unfair practice.

required.title: No personalised insurance advice without a licence
required.description: Avoid individualised recommendations that require a licensed producer.
required.rationale: Personalised insurance advice requires licensing.

required.title: Protect policyholder data
required.description: Secure policy, payment, and any health data in interactions and logs.
required.rationale: Policyholder data is sensitive personal data.

recommended.title: Treat vulnerable customers fairly
recommended.description: Detect vulnerability and adapt support; avoid pressure.
recommended.rationale: Fair treatment of vulnerable customers is required.

required.title: Surface risk signals, not accusations
required.description: Provide indicators for SIU review; never assert fraud to the claimant.
required.rationale: Definitive automated fraud accusations are defamatory and risky.

required.title: Protect investigation data and avoid tip-off
required.description: Keep investigation material confidential and out of claimant-facing channels.
required.rationale: Investigation confidentiality protects integrity and rights.

required.title: Human review before denial or referral
required.description: Require human authorisation before adverse action or law-enforcement referral.
required.rationale: Consequential decisions require oversight.

recommended.title: Monitor for disparate impact in fraud flags
recommended.description: Check flags do not disproportionately target protected groups.
recommended.rationale: Biased fraud detection can be discriminatory.

required.title: Protect order, account, and payment data
required.description: Mask payment and personal data; never echo full card numbers.
required.rationale: Order/payment data is personal data and in PCI scope.

required.title: Detect and block prompt injection / jailbreaks
required.description: Filter attempts to override instructions or exfiltrate data via crafted inputs.
required.rationale: Public-facing agents are prime prompt-injection targets.

required.title: No invented discounts or refund promises
required.description: Block commitments (discounts, refunds, price matches) beyond approved policy.
required.rationale: Unauthorised promises are deceptive and costly.

recommended.title: Filter toxic or abusive content
recommended.description: Apply input/output filters for hate, harassment, and profanity.
recommended.rationale: Protects customers and brand.

required.title: No false or unsubstantiated product claims
required.description: Block deceptive, exaggerated, or unsubstantiated performance/health claims.
required.rationale: Deceptive advertising harms consumers and is unlawful.

required.title: Disclose AI use and sponsored recommendations
required.description: Tell users they're interacting with AI and clearly mark sponsored/affiliate recommendations.
required.rationale: Material connections and AI use must be disclosed.

required.title: No medical or safety claims for regulated products
required.description: Avoid health/medical claims for supplements, cosmetics, or other regulated goods.
required.rationale: Health claims on regulated products are restricted.

recommended.title: Protect preference and profile data
recommended.description: Secure profiling/preference data used for recommendations.
recommended.rationale: Profile data is personal data.

required.title: Ground refund/return decisions in policy
required.description: Base outcomes on the actual return policy; do not invent entitlements or refuse statutory rights.
required.rationale: Inconsistent or invented resolutions create disputes and legal risk.

required.title: Protect payment and refund data
required.description: Secure card and refund details; never echo full payment data.
required.rationale: Refund flows handle in-scope payment data.

required.title: Honour statutory return and refund rights
required.description: Surface and respect statutory cooling-off/return rights where they apply.
required.rationale: Consumers have non-waivable statutory rights.

recommended.title: Guard large refunds and policy exceptions
recommended.description: Route high-value refunds or out-of-policy exceptions to a human.
recommended.rationale: High-impact financial actions need oversight.

required.title: No deceptive or unsubstantiated advertising
required.description: Block unsubstantiated claims, fake urgency, and misleading comparisons in generated copy.
required.rationale: Deceptive advertising is unlawful.

required.title: Avoid IP infringement and unsafe brand content
required.description: Prevent use of third-party trademarks/copyright and off-brand or unsafe content.
required.rationale: Infringing or unsafe content creates legal and brand risk.

required.title: No discriminatory targeting or content
required.description: Block protected-class exclusion in ad targeting and discriminatory messaging.
required.rationale: Discriminatory ad targeting/content is unlawful in regulated categories.

recommended.title: Label AI-generated and endorsement content
recommended.description: Mark AI-generated creative and disclose material connections in endorsements.
recommended.rationale: Transparency obligations apply to AI and endorsements.

required.title: Honour US consumer-protection and state privacy rights
required.description: Respect state privacy rights (access/delete/opt-out) and avoid unfair or deceptive practices in any US-facing interaction.
required.rationale: US users are covered by the FTC Act and state privacy statutes.

recommended.title: Be ready for state breach-notification duties
recommended.description: Log access to personal data sufficiently to support state breach-notification obligations.
recommended.rationale: Most US states mandate breach notification within set timeframes.

required.title: Comply with UK data-protection law
required.description: Apply UK GDPR principles (lawfulness, minimisation, security) and support data-subject rights for UK users.
required.rationale: UK personal data is governed by UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

recommended.title: Follow ICO guidance on AI transparency
recommended.description: Be transparent about automated processing and provide meaningful explanations per ICO expectations.
recommended.rationale: The ICO sets expectations for transparency and fairness in AI systems.
regulations: ICO Guidance on AI and Data Protection

required.title: Apply HIPAA safeguards to Protected Health Information
required.description: Enforce minimum-necessary use, access controls, and encryption for any PHI handled.
required.rationale: PHI is protected under the HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules.

required.title: Respect applicable APAC data-protection laws
required.description: Honour consent, purpose-limitation, and any data-localisation requirements in the relevant Asia-Pacific jurisdictions.
required.rationale: APAC jurisdictions impose their own consent and localisation rules.

required.title: Require human approval before executing transactions or actions
required.description: Gate any state-changing action (payments, trades, transfers, record updates) behind explicit human authorisation, with a reversal path.
required.rationale: Solely automated actions with legal or financial effect require human oversight.

recommended.title: Log and rate-limit autonomous actions
recommended.description: Record every autonomous action with inputs/outputs and apply rate and value limits.
recommended.rationale: Auditability and limits contain the blast radius of automated actions.

required.title: Minimise, encrypt, and access-control sensitive data
required.description: Apply data minimisation, encryption in transit and at rest, and least-privilege access to the sensitive categories handled.
required.rationale: Sensitive personal, financial, or health data requires heightened technical and organisational controls.

recommended.title: Disclose AI interaction to end users
recommended.description: Tell external users they are interacting with an AI system and how to reach a human.
recommended.rationale: Transparency obligations apply to consumer-facing AI.

required.title: Honour GDPR data-subject rights
required.description: Support access, rectification, and erasure requests and avoid processing that obstructs these rights.
required.rationale: EU data subjects can invoke access/erasure/rectification rights; the agent must not obstruct them or process data unlawfully.

recommended.title: Disclose automated processing and lawful basis
recommended.description: Inform EU users they are interacting with an AI system and disclose the lawful basis for processing.
recommended.rationale: GDPR requires transparency about automated processing and a defined lawful basis.
